admission_details.quote: Students are required to declare their major by the time they have completed the first 45 credits of their degree. Many students arrive at Lewis & Clark completely undecided, many have some ideas, many say they already know what they will major in. Regardless of which of these categories you fit into, we encourage you to explore our curriculum in your first year. … Fill out and submit the major/minor declaration form on the Registrar’s website. Once the form has been processed by the Registrar’s office, you will be officially declared.
admission_details.criteria_text: Students declare a major by form (with a faculty advisor) by 45 completed credits; no application to the major is printed.
